confirmed_blocking.evidence: git diff origin/main...HEAD adds to core/roles/code-build.md:17 'Per behaviour-changing task: write or extend a test, run it and observe it fail before any implementation code, then the smallest code that passes, then refactor only while tests are green...' (ENG-1) plus the bounded reuse search (ENG-6); :21 'Commit each task once, test and implementation together; no separate red commit' (ENG-3); :22 'Red: <test name> failed as expected' or 'Red: not applicable - <existing test> already covers this'. No other wording counts (ENG-2's red-proof contract, also the exact forms in engineering.md's 'Red proof' section); :23-25 the seam stop (ENG-4), the un-runnable-command stop (a reference definition) and the exemption rule (ENG-5). fixer.md:17-19 and :21-23 repeat the same set. review-judge.md:19 adds 'a finding whose cited id is ENG-7..ENG-10 is at most MEDIUM and never blocking, lowered rather than dropped...' then ends 'point at them, do not restate them'. FR-001: 'no role restates them inline'; SC-004: 'zero inline restatements'; DESIGN.md 'Engineering discipline': 'Every role that writes, plans, reviews or judges code points at it and restates no rule inline.' tasks.md T013's own check ('engineering.md is the only file under core/ stating a rule's content') is false for the shipped tree.
confirmed_blocking.fix: In code-build.md, fixer.md and review-judge.md keep only the stage wiring (the reference is followed, when to stop, what to return, commit subject and Red-line placement) and replace duplicated rule content with citations ('per ENG-1'..'per ENG-6'); trim the ceiling restatement in review-judge.md and code-standards.md the same way. Re-render all four harnesses and commit dist/ with the source (constitution III).

The runner-setup-first-task half is present (tasks override: 'when the repository has no test runner, the runner-setup task is task 1').
confirmed_blocking.fix: Restore the constraint in the plan-stage override of core/roles/spec-builder.md: '`Test runner: <runner> - <why>` only when the repository has none — the language's conventional default, named with the reason so the user can object at the approver gate'; re-render all four harnesses and commit dist/.
